## F — Structured research index

Open verification debts for this section: none. Every provisional night rules, driver license categories and endorsements, the performance test, renewal, duplicate and restricted licenses, registry, donor and veteran notations, mopeds, license display and citations claim in parts C and C-two carries a page-bound anchor, and part D raised no accuracy flag.

Exam facts recorded as unknown (question count, passing standard, time limit, format) are terminal unknown states from part A, not open debts; they need no VERIFY entry.

Market and teardown scope statements live in parts E and E-two; audience and exam-authority context live in parts B and A.

Consolidated VERIFY list: empty for this section. The image-only third page and the graphic age numeral are recorded as source-form cautions in part D, not as open debts, because the rendered page states each fact plainly.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the provisional night rules, driver license categories and endorsements, the performance test, renewal, duplicate and restricted licenses, registry, donor and veteran notations, mopeds, license display and citations rules on pages 14–17 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
